gamelab.title: Ubisoft Gamelab
whatIsParagraphs: The Game Lab is a university competition organized by Ubisoft, held every year during the winter semester. It's open to full-time undergraduate and graduate students.
Teams have 10 weeks to build a video game prototype. Each team — made up of eight students from various fields of expertise (programming, art, design, etc.) — is guided by two Ubisoft mentors.
gamelab.participateIntro: Registration opens during the fall semester on the club's Discord. Here are a few things that can improve your chances of being selected:
participateList: Having worked on several personal or team projects
Getting the competition credited as a capstone (PFE) or internship (PS) project
gamelab.benefitsText: A unique chance to stand out in Quebec's video game industry, learn as a team, and benefit from the experience of industry professionals.
